text:
mia: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a small addendum to the staged upgrade flow: add a serializer-versioned backstop image and a lightweight checksum manifest for delta replay. goal is to make rollbacks and partial-applies idempotent across operator reboots.

raj: +1 on the idea. can you sketch what "serializer-versioned" buys us vs embedding a compatibility shim?

mia: The serializer version tags the content encoding we ship in deltas. v1 = compact tar+lz4, v2 = chunked zstd with per-chunk checksums. If a node advertises v1 only, controller will fallback to full-image swap. avoids runtime shim code on agents.

sam: fallback to full-image swap sounds expensive for big fleets. what's the backstop image size?

mia: backstop image is expected to be a minimal runtime + verifier + apply-engine (~120MB gz). It contains a noop delta replayer that can fast-path verified manifests to the on-disk store.

elaine: thinking about operator UX: if we add serializer versions, we need a discovery endpoint on the verifier agent so the control plane can route deltas by capability. can be simple: `GET /capabilities` -> {"serializer":["v1","v2"]} and `POST /delta` accepts a header `X-Serializer: v2`.

jules: +1 for capability negotiation. also we should include a compatibility matrix in the release notes — ops will want to know when older airgapped clusters must pull backstop images.

raj: one more tradeoff: adding per-chunk checksums increases manifest size ~8-12% but makes partial apply resumable and allows aggressive garbage collection of staged blobs. i think it's worth it.

mia: agreed. Proposal: manifest format version 3: fields -> serializer, chunks:[{sha256,size}], backstop_uri(optional), apply_mode: [stream|swap], signer_key_id. Keep it minimal.

sam: do we want an apply_mode=stream that streams into place vs swap that writes to tmp and swap? streaming is lower mem but harder to rollback mid-apply.

elaine: i'd default to swap for safety, allow stream for low-memory devices under an explicit operator flag. Need clear operator warnings in console.

ops-bot: deploy-check: manifest-v3 schema validated; 2 nodes in staging reported missing v2 capability — staging rollout will use swap fallback.

mia: good catch ops-bot. action items: (1) add /capabilities endpoint + header handling (2) implement manifest-v3 encoder/decoder in packager (3) create backstop minimal image build and publish artifact manifest (4) docs + release matrix. i'll draft a short RFC patch.

raj: callout: compatibility policy — we support mixed clusters for 2 weeks per release, after which control plane will warn and then reject v1-only nodes for new deltas. ops needs to advertise that window.

jules: put that window in the console rollout modal too. one more: include a health-check route on backstop image so installers can verify integrity before reboot.

mia: noted. i'll include health-check endpoint `/healthz?manifest=<sha256>` which verifies backstop can replay manifest header and return 200.

sam: can we add a small sample CLI snippet for ops? e.g. `redwoodctl agent-capabilities --host 10.0.0.3` and `redwoodctl push-delta --serializer v2 delta.tar.zst`

elaine: sounds good. i'll coordinate docs and console UX with the product PM.

mia: thanks all — i'll post the RFC patch in a follow-up thread and tag @jules @raj for review. :thumbsup:
